<style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            /* Primary green from estimate section: linear-gradient(135deg, #2d4a3e 0%, #3d5a4e 100%) */
            --primary-green: #3a5a4d;
            --primary-green-light: #4a6b5d;
            --secondary-green: #4a7462;
            --light-green: #5a8472;
            --accent-green: #6a9482;
            --cream: #f5f3ef;
            --warm-gray: #4a4a4a;
            --light-gray: #e8e8e8;
            --gold: #c9a961;
            --white: #ffffff;
            --off-white: #fafafa;
            --dark: #1a1a1a;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom,
                    var(--white) 0%,
                    #fcfcfc 15%,
                    #f9faf9 30%,
                    #f6f8f6 50%,
                    #f3f6f4 70%,
                    #f0f4f2 85%,
                    var(--cream) 100%);
        }

        h1,
        h2,
        h3,
        h4 {
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            color: var(--dark);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        /* Navigation - Desktop Minimal */
        .navbar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.08);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .navbar.scrolled {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.08);
        }

        .nav-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 1.25rem 2rem;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .logo img {
            height: 100px;
            width: auto;
            object-fit: contain;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .logo:hover img {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            .logo img {
                height: 80px;
            }
        }

        .nav-menu {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2.5rem;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .nav-link {
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            position: relative;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .nav-link::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -4px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--primary-green);
            transition: width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .nav-link:hover,
        .nav-link.active {
            color: var(--primary-green);
        }

        .nav-link:hover::after,
        .nav-link.active::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .nav-cta {
            background: var(--primary-green);
            color: var(--white);
            padding: 0.8rem 1.8rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            text-decoration: none;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .nav-cta:hover {
            background: var(--primary-green-light);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.25);
        }

        .mobile-toggle {
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.6rem;
            z-index: 1001;
        }

        .hamburger {
            width: 26px;
            height: 2.5px;
            background: var(--primary-green);
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .mobile-toggle.active .hamburger:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(6px, 6px);
        }

        .mobile-toggle.active .hamburger:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-10px);
        }

        .mobile-toggle.active .hamburger:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(6px, -6px);
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 95vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 80px;
        }

        .hero-background {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .hero-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            filter: brightness(1.05) contrast(1.1);
        }

        .hero-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg,
                    rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.92) 0%,
                    rgba(74, 107, 93, 0.85) 40%,
                    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 100%);
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 3rem 2rem;
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .hero h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 4.5rem);
            color: var(--white);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            line-height: 1.1;
            max-width: 900px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }

        .hero-subtitle {
            font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.6rem);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
            font-weight: 500;
            max-width: 700px;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .hero-description {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.15rem);
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            max-width: 650px;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
        }

        .hero-buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .primary-button {
            background: var(--white);
            color: var(--primary-green);
            padding: 1.3rem 2.8rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            border: 2px solid transparent;
            display: inline-block;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .primary-button:hover {
            background: var(--cream);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
        }

        .secondary-button {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--white);
            padding: 1.3rem 2.8rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            display: inline-block;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .secondary-button:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            border-color: var(--white);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        .trust-signals {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 3rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .trust-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3rem;
        }

        .stars {
            color: var(--gold);
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
        }

        .trust-number {
            font-size: 2rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--white);
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .trust-text {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        }

        /* Services Section - Staggered Grid */
        .services {
            padding: 8rem 2rem;
            background: transparent;
        }

        .section-header {
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto 5rem;
        }

        .section-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--primary-green);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }

        .section-subtitle {
            font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.3rem);
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .services-grid {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
            gap: 2.5rem;
        }

        .service-card:nth-child(even) {
            margin-top: 3rem;
        }

        .service-card {
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 16px;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.08);
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.06);
        }

        .service-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-12px);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.15);
            border-color: rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.12);
        }

        .service-image {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 280px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .service-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .service-card:hover .service-image img {
            transform: scale(1.08);
        }

        .service-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 40%, rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.5));
            opacity: 0.7;
            transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
        }

        .service-card:hover .service-overlay {
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        .service-content {
            padding: 2.2rem;
        }

        .service-content h3 {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            color: var(--primary-green);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .service-content p {
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
            font-size: 1rem;
        }

        .learn-more {
            color: var(--primary-green);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            transition: gap 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .learn-more:hover {
            gap: 1.2rem;
        }

        /* Why Choose Us - Masonry Style */
        .why-us {
            padding: 8rem 2rem;
            background: transparent;
        }

        .features-grid {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 2.5rem;
        }

        .feature:nth-child(odd) {
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }

        .feature {
            text-align: center;
            transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .feature:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);
        }

        .feature-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 260px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.08);
        }

        .feature-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .feature:hover .feature-image img {
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .feature h3 {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            color: var(--primary-green);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .feature p {
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            line-height: 1.7;
            font-size: 1rem;
        }

        /* Process Section - Asymmetric Grid */
        .process {
            padding: 8rem 2rem;
            background: transparent;
        }

        .process-container {
            max-width: 1300px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 3rem;
        }

        .process-step {
            position: relative;
            text-align: center;
            transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .process-step:nth-child(2) {
            margin-top: 2.5rem;
        }

        .process-step:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
        }

        .step-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: -25px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 70px;
            height: 70px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #d4a956);
            color: var(--dark);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(201, 169, 97, 0.3);
            z-index: 1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .process-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 260px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.1);
            border: 1px solid rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.08);
        }

        .process-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .process-step:hover .process-image img {
            transform: scale(1.08);
        }

        .process-step h3 {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            color: var(--primary-green);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .process-step p {
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            line-height: 1.7;
            font-size: 1rem;
        }

        /* CTA Section */
        .cta-section {
            padding: 8rem 2rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg,
                    rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.03) 0%,
                    rgba(74, 107, 93, 0.05) 50%,
                    rgba(90, 132, 114, 0.08) 100%);
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--primary-green);
        }

        .cta-content h2 {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 3.8rem);
            color: var(--primary-green);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
        }

        .cta-content p {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 1.6rem);
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
            color: var(--warm-gray);
        }

        .cta-contact {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 4rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 3rem;
        }

            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;

        .contact-info:hover {
            color: var(--gold);

            font-size: 0.95rem;
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            font-weight: 500;

            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;

            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            z-index: 2000;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 2rem;
            animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
        }

        .modal-overlay.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
            }

            to {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(30px);
            }

            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: 20px;
            max-width: 600px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            animation: slideUp 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            position: relative;
        }

        .modal-header {
            padding: 2.5rem 2.5rem 1rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.1);
        }

        .modal-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 1.5rem;
            right: 1.5rem;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            font-size: 2rem;
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            cursor: pointer;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 50%;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .modal-close:hover {
            background: rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.1);
            color: var(--primary-green);
        }

        .modal-header h3 {
            color: var(--primary-green);
            font-size: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .modal-header p {
            color: var(--warm-gray);
            font-size: 1rem;
        }

        .modal-body {
            padding: 2rem 2.5rem 2.5rem;
        }

        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .form-group label {
            display: block;
            color: var(--dark);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;

        .form-group select,

            width: 100%;
            padding: 1rem;
            border: 2px solid var(--light-gray);
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .form-group input:focus,
        .form-group select:focus,
        .form-group textarea:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--primary-green);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.1);
        }

        .form-group textarea {
            resize: vertical;
            min-height: 120px;
        }

            width: 100%;
            background: var(--primary-green);
            color: var(--white);
            padding: 1.3rem;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;

            box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(58, 90, 77, 0.25);

            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
            padding: 4rem 2rem 2rem;

        .footer-content {
            max-width: 1400px;

            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));

            margin-bottom: 3rem;

            font-size: 1.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .footer-section p {
            line-height: 1.8;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);

        .footer-owner {
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--gold);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

            text-decoration: none;
            line-height: 2;
            display: block;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;

        .footer-section a:hover {
            color: var(--gold);

            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);

            text-align: center;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
        }

            .nav-menu {
                position: fixed;
                top: 0;
                left: -70%;
                width: 70%;
                height: 100vh;

        }
